'''Martina Havenith-Newen''' (born 13 April 1963 in [[Mechernich]]) is a German chemist.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.leopoldina.org/fileadmin/redaktion/Mitglieder/CV_Havenith-Newen_Martina_D.pdf|title=CV Havenith-Newen|website=www.leopoldina.org|access-date=2018-12-15}}</ref>

== Education and career ==
She studied physics and mathematics at the [[University of Bonn]] from 1981 to 1987.<ref name=":0" /> She finished her doctorate in physics in 1990<ref>{{Cite thesis|title=Infrared spectroscopy of van der Waals complexes and ions|date=1990|language=de|first=Martina|last=Havenith|oclc = 46007671}}</ref> and completed her habilitation in 1997.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite thesis|title=Infrared spectroscopy as a tool for the understanding of intermolecular forces|date=1997|place=Bonn|language=und|first=Martina|last=Havenith-Newen|oclc = 1070754385}}</ref>

Since 1998, she is a professor at the [[Ruhr University Bochum]].<ref name=":0" />

== Research ==
Her research focuses on intermolecular interactions, aggregation, solvation, molecular recognition, and infra-red and THz spectroscopy.<ref name=":1" />

== Awards ==
She is a member of the [[Academy of Sciences Leopoldina]],<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Mitgliederverzeichnis|url=https://www.leopoldina.org/mitgliederverzeichnis/mitglieder/member/Member/show/martina-havenith-newen/|access-date=January 14, 2022|website=www.leopoldina.org|language=de}}</ref> the [[Academy of Europe]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Havenith-Newen_Martina|title=Academy of Europe: Havenith-Newen Martina|website=www.ae-info.org|access-date=2018-12-15}}</ref> and the [[:de:Wissenschaftsrat (Österreich)|Österreichischer Wissenschaftsrat]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.wissenschaftsrat.ac.at/raete|title=Räte {{!}} Wissenschaftsrat Österreich|website=www.wissenschaftsrat.ac.at|language=de|access-date=2018-12-15}}</ref>
